meta.title: Vista Content & Campaign Plan
meta.basis: Built on the ten Vista patient personas (P01–P10), the CDS roadmap (Months 1–3 on a frozen media structure, booking signal live 12 Mar 2027, go-live 22 Jan 2027) and a flexible 5–8 posts a month (up to 4 reels, 2 carousels, 2 static). Budget weighting per campaign is set separately at the Day-30 media audit (1 Dec 2026).

personas.P03: Worried Parent of a Myopic Child
personas.P04: Adult Child Arranging a Parent's Cataract Surgery
personas.P05: Senior Who Wants to See the Doctor in Person

pillars.name: Know Your Eyes
pillars.job: Name the symptom before the patient names the procedure. Most personas start with a sign they have noticed, not a treatment they want.
pillars.formats: Reels (symptom explainers), carousels (sign-by-sign), TikTok BM re-cuts
pillars.languages: EN, BM, ZH — BM first on TikTok, ZH for cataract and myopia

series.d: One symptom per reel: blurry night driving, glare, rising prescription, burning eyes. Ends with 'when to get it checked'.
Carousel myth-and-fact on ageing eyes, screen use and children's vision.
World Glaucoma Week (Mar), World Sight Day (14 Oct) — educational only.

examples: Reel (BM): 'Silau bila memandu waktu malam? 3 tanda awal katarak'
Carousel (EN): 'Your child's glasses got thicker again — what that means'
Reel (ZH): 老花眼 vs 白内障 — 有什么不同？
pillars.guard: Educational content; no treatment claims, no outcome promises.

pillars.name: Weigh Your Options
pillars.job: Answer the questions the chat assistant fails to answer today: suitability, recovery in days, how the options differ, what it costs to plan for.
pillars.formats: Reels (day-of-procedure walk-through), carousels (comparison of options by criteria, not by clinic), static (instalment explained)
pillars.languages: EN, ZH; BM re-cuts for TikTok

series.d: Carousel set comparing the options by corneal thickness, prescription range, recovery and follow-up.

series.n: Day of Procedure, Step by Step
series.d: Reel showing arrival to discharge in the clinic, with timings.
What day 1, day 7 and day 30 look like, stated plainly.
Static on the 0% instalment plan and panel/insurance options, with the approved price range.

examples: Carousel (EN): 'Told you can't do LASIK? Three things we check next'
Reel (ZH): 'CLEAR PRO 手术当天 — 从到达到回家'
Static (EN): 'iLASIK on a 24-month 0% instalment plan — approved price shown'
pillars.measure: Saves, link clicks to procedure pages, WhatsApp starts with procedure keyword
pillars.guard: Price and package posts need MAB approval; no price comparison with other providers; no 'painless' or guarantee language.

pillars.name: Every Age, Every Eye
pillars.job: Speak to the person making the decision for someone else — the parent of a myopic child and the adult child of a cataract patient.
pillars.formats: Carousels (checklists), reels (clinic walk-through for kids and seniors), Facebook-first
pillars.languages: EN, BM, ZH (Facebook and WhatsApp-shareable formats)

series.d: Atropine, red-light therapy and control lenses explained; what a 12-month plan involves.

series.n: Taking Mum or Dad for Cataract Surgery
series.d: Checklist: documents, insurance/panel, how many trips, aftercare at home.
Timed to Nov–Jan and mid-year holidays.

examples: Carousel (BM): 'Bawa ibu untuk pembedahan katarak? Senarai semak 5 perkara'
Reel (EN): 'What happens at a kids' eye exam — from a child's height'
Static (ZH): 孩子近视加深太快？ 学校假期带来检查
pillars.measure: Shares (WhatsApp forwards), saves, kids and cataract WhatsApp starts
pillars.guard: No child or patient testimonials about treatment; child imagery with guardian consent.

pillars.name: Screen Life
pillars.job: Earn attention from younger audiences with relatable, low-effort habits — the reach engine for TikTok and Reels.
pillars.formats: Reels and TikTok natives, trend formats, office POV skits, static quote cards
pillars.languages: BM and EN on TikTok; EN/ZH on Instagram

series.d: Office POV reels on screen breaks, lighting and blinking.
Humour: fogged masks, gym, swimming, rain — the everyday case for knowing your options.
Short, practical guidance parents can apply tonight.

examples: TikTok (BM): 'POV: cermin mata berkabus lepas keluar dari kereta'
Reel (EN): 'Burning eyes by 4 pm? Try this at your desk'
pillars.measure: Views, follows, shares; TikTok cost per result on boosted posts
pillars.guard: Keep humour away from surgical outcomes; no influencer references to treatment received.

pillars.name: Inside Vista
pillars.job: Build trust through what can lawfully be shown: the clinics, the process, the technology and the people, stated factually.
pillars.formats: Reels (branch walk-throughs, technology explainers), carousels (meet the clinical team), LinkedIn quarterly

series.d: One branch a month from the 16 centres: parking, entrance, waiting area, hours.
What a piece of diagnostic or surgical equipment does, in plain words.
Names, roles and qualifications stated factually — no skill or outcome claims.
Award announcements and community work (award announcements are exempt from MAB approval; wording still reviewed).

examples: Reel (EN): 'Mount Austin JB — parking, entrance and where to check in'
LinkedIn (EN): 'How we run a sterile theatre day'
pillars.measure: Profile visits, branch page clicks, direction requests on Google Business Profile
pillars.guard: MAB 3/2023 does not permit promoting an individual practitioner's skills or experience; facility-hospitality comments are the only permitted testimonial type.

pillars.name: Plan Your Visit
pillars.job: Remove the last reasons not to book: how to book, which branch, how many trips, what's on this month.
pillars.formats: Static and stories (approved offers, branch hours, festive hours), reels (how to book on WhatsApp), pinned posts

series.d: WhatsApp booking flow, weekend slots, what to bring.
For Singapore and East Malaysia patients: trips, stay, follow-up plan.
Approved campaign offers (Carnival, Open House) and branch events.

examples: Reel (EN): 'Coming from Singapore? Plan your JB visit in two trips'
Story (BM): 'Waktu operasi cawangan sepanjang Hari Raya'
pillars.measure: WhatsApp starts, bookings attributed to social (from the booking signal, 12 Mar 2027)
pillars.guard: Offers need MAB approval; free services and gifts are not permitted; screening events cannot be advertised as free.

campaigns.name: Clear Choice
campaigns.objective: Turn refractive interest into booked suitability assessments; lift the paid booking rate from 1.5%.
campaigns.insight: Refractive conversations grew from 437 (Sep 2025) to 2,370 (Aug 2026) a month, yet every price question in the sample went unanswered.
campaigns.message: Know if you're suitable in one visit. See the price before you book.
campaigns.channels: Google Search (refractive × region × language) · Meta click-to-WhatsApp · TikTok (post-pilot) · Instagram Reels
creative: 'Three things we check before LASIK' carousel → comparison landing page
Instalment static with the approved monthly figure
ICL-specific search ads for 'can't do LASIK' queries (P02)
campaigns.landing: Refractive comparison hub with suitability check, price range and weekend slots
campaigns.crm: Ad-aware assistant answers price and instalment, offers two slots; ICL keywords routed to a refractive counsellor; two follow-ups before any auto-close
kpis: Refractive cost per booked appointment reported monthly

campaigns.name: Bring Them Clarity
campaigns.objective: Reach the adult child who decides and pays, and the senior who decides alone, with one clear path to a cataract assessment.
campaigns.insight: Cataract is the largest enquiry category (12,853 conversations in 12 months) while the 'cataract surgery' ranking fell out of the top 100.
campaigns.message: We'll sort the insurance and the trips. You focus on your parent.
campaigns.channels: Google Search (EN/ZH/BM) · Meta (Facebook-first, 30+ caregivers and 55+) · YouTube shorts · branch Google Business Profiles
creative: 'Taking Mum for cataract surgery' checklist carousel (BM/ZH), built to be forwarded on WhatsApp
'Glare when driving at night?' symptom reel for 55+
Branch walk-through videos for the parent's nearest centre
Raya creative in BM (Feb–Mar): 'Balik kampung, check mata mak'
campaigns.landing: Cataract guide for families with insurance/panel checklist and branch finder
campaigns.crm: Caregiver path collects insurer/panel, parent's branch and language; coordinator owns the record; post-op reminders in the parent's language
kpis: Phone bookings logged in the CRM (currently 0)

campaigns.name: Slow the Blur
campaigns.services: Kids eye exam · Myopia Control Program
campaigns.objective: Book kids' eye exams in the school holidays and enrol children into 12-month myopia control plans.
campaigns.insight: Kids pages drew 15,656 sessions in three languages; the separate kids Messenger channel handled only 187 conversations in a year.
campaigns.message: Myopia can be slowed. Check your child during the school holidays.
campaigns.channels: Meta (parents 30–45) · Google Search · TikTok BM · optometrist and school referral kit
creative: 'What happens at a kids' eye exam' reel filmed at child height
Referral leaflet and QR code for partner optometrists
campaigns.landing: Kids eye exam page with weekend and holiday slots
campaigns.crm: Parent path (child's age, current power, last check); reminders to both parents; programme renewal prompt at month 11
kpis: Kids exams booked per holiday window

campaigns.name: Screen-Tired Eyes
campaigns.objective: Convert symptom searches into Dry Eye Assessments at the approved price.
campaigns.insight: Dry-eye pages drew 10,508 sessions, while 2025 procedure-style ads bought enquiries far above the network average.
campaigns.message: Tired, burning eyes aren't just screen time. Get them assessed.
campaigns.channels: Google Search (symptom terms) · Meta (office workers) · Instagram Reels · corporate wellness partners
creative: Assessment static with approved price and after-work slots
campaigns.landing: Dry-eye symptom checker leading to assessment booking
campaigns.crm: Assessment booking type; panel field; programme check-ins at weeks 2, 6 and 12

campaigns.name: Reading Freedom
campaigns.objective: Capture high-value reading-vision demand through search and AI answers; decide LinkedIn on evidence.
campaigns.insight: 'rle eye surgery' reached position 1 in Jul 2026 with no campaign behind it; LinkedIn has 689 followers.
campaigns.message: One procedure for reading vision — decided in one consultation.

guardrails.r: No free healthcare offers or gifts
guardrails.d: MAB guideline 3/2023 does not permit free offers of healthcare services or any form of gift. Screening days and Open House are advertised as events, not as free services.
Individual prices and packages may be advertised with approval; comparing prices or packages with other providers is not permitted. Singapore creative talks about trips and planning, not savings.
Patient comments may cover cleanliness and staff hospitality. Comments on treatment results or a doctor's skill are not permitted, including reposted reviews.

guardrails.r: No promotion of an individual practitioner's skills
guardrails.d: 'Meet the Clinical Team' states names, roles and qualifications only. No case counts, 'most experienced' or outcome language.
No creator may reference treatment they received. Screen Life creator content stays on habits and everyday life.
'Top #1', 'Best #1', 'guaranteed', 'painless', '99% safety rate' and milestone counts come out of all creative until approved wording exists.

Advertisements need MAB approval unless exempt (educational articles and award announcements are exempt). Seasonal creative is submitted six weeks before launch; approved evergreen runs if approval slips.

assumptions: 2027 school holiday dates were still 'TBA' at the time of writing (school starts 4 Jan 2027 for Group B). Kids windows follow the roadmap (to 3 Jan; late May–June) and move when KPM publishes the calendar.
2027 public holidays per the published calendar: CNY 6–7 Feb, Aidilfitri 10–11 Mar, Haji 17–18 May, Wesak 20 May, Malaysia Day 16 Sep, Deepavali 28 Oct. These may change on cabinet confirmation.
Campaign weighting is set at the Day-30 media audit (1 Dec 2026) and reviewed at the pilot evidence review (26 Mar 2027).
Offer figures shown as [approved] are placeholders until Vista's price list and MAB approval are in hand.
Xiaohongshu, Indonesian-language content and a LinkedIn pilot are tests outside the RFP social minimum; they proceed only if Vista agrees the scope.
